execution.scope: Synthetic direct-library execution on CPU3. Fresh encoder, decoder and repeat machines use the same review process; this review does not independently repeat the author's separate-process CLI phases.

independent_fixture.interpretation: The first field is constant while the second changes and the third supplies the adjacent selector. On the third target K/T select a8; O/R/S select b8. This distinguishes adjacent selection from original-first selection and from a hardcoded second-field shortcut.

additional_independent_checks: An unaligned previous-field span blocks adjacent selection while original-first selection remains active; unaligned original-first with aligned adjacent remains eligible only for adjacent selection.
Overwrite changes recency serial without refreshing FIFO insertion order; conditional, recency and rotated donors agree with that distinction.
Seven valid, duplicate, nested, overlong and incomplete suffix cases preserve 5166 pre-divergence probability and complete-state boundaries. Only complete valid invocations commit adjacent pairs.
All 256 byte values plus a synthetic exceptional-byte field reconstruct exactly in all six framed codec arms; the arbitrary-byte fixture has 272 raw bytes.
static_review: The mutation selects only fields[-1:] for K/T/R/S and delegates O to the original first-field selector.
Adjacent association insertion occurs only on a completed valid invocation and requires aligned previous and target WRT spans with a bounded target donor.
The predecessor parser, decoder and arithmetic coder sources remain hash-bound and unchanged.
FIFO capacity, deterministic serial replacement and policy-salted complete-state identity remain explicit.

The synthetic harness binds raw length/hash, dictionary hash, mode and payload length in an 81-byte header, counts dictionary bytes and the external K bookkeeping option separately, and checks canonical native re-encoding.

limits.qualification: Synthetic implementation correctness and selector separation only. Source, interpreter and dependency closure remain uncounted. Every measured synthetic archive is larger than the 132-byte raw fixture. These measurements establish neither corpus gain nor complete-package economics.
